notes.title: Wacky's Funhouse / Scamper
notes.content:
Unlike the ghosts -Boo Men isn't dead! A long-awaited Spring update is here!

A New Map
Wacky's Funhouse!
Your glowstick won't be of much use here, as neither will the lights! Wacky's Funhouse offers a brightly-lit environment with animated obstacles and fun to explore areas with no wrong turns!


A New Boo Man
Scamper
The skinless stalker who does not like to be seen! Scamper likes to sneak up on its victim when they aren't looking. Turn around too fast and it will be instant lights out! So keep your eyes down when running through the dark and don't look at anything looking back at you!
Oh, and one more thing to note; It is only seeable by the person it is stalking...


Quality of life

 3 New Masks (all glow in the dark)
Cosmic (animated), Hypno (animated), Polka Dots
 Added tips upon death for new players who don't read the ghost guide
 Added some UI sounds to the main menu + updated load screen
 Fixed jumpscare sometimes showing the Scav no matter who killed you
 Fixed 'Close' button in Ghost Guide not showing on some monitor resolutions
 Other minor bug fixes and changes


Additional future updates in queue (not in order):

 End game stats page for multiplayer (and some for single player as well)
(# of items found per player, player revives, time spent in light/number of lights turned on, power outages, etc...)
 Better functioning server browser
 Arnie and Scamper in PvP
 Random weather effects (rain, thunder, lightning, clear)
 Additional Perks
 Leveling up system
 Extra environment paranormal events
 PvP Custom Settings


There are some things that I may have missed, but just @ me on Discord or comment here if you have anything you would like to see in game! 
Thank you everyone for your continued support! A lot of efforts have been shifted to a new and upcoming project which is why updates have been further apart, but I still plan on continuing updates with Boo Men for a long time!
:) Happy Spring!

notes.title: Holiday Fright
notes.content:
Tis' the season of [strike]giving[/strike] taking!
A holiday update has arrived!

Holiday Event
Holiday festivities are taking place on Riverglen!
Collect all 10 gifts for a special prize! Each present will give the player a fun effect, but be warned... There are 5 naughty gifts hidden around the house as well that will grant the player a negative effect!

A New Boo Man
Santa isn't the only thing stopping by this year... Meet Arnie; a chainsaw wielding Boo Man that behaves as 2 separate entities working together as one!

Quality of Life

Big improvements to Riverglen and Leroy Est.
Players now hold actual glow sticks (and can see other player's glow stick)
Updated alarm to instead give a 4 digit number the player must guess in the correct order and they will now have 60s to disable it (use to be 30s).
All Boo Men have had slight changes to their behavior to make them more fair to play against
Minor bug fixes that I don't keep track of

notes.title: Event Ended
notes.content:
The Halloween event has ended and updates for the holidays have begun (which is the reason for the download size).
Also:

Revive doll has 45 second timer to auto revive player if it does not reach them by then
The Troll now permanently glows again and his roar cooldown has been increased
Not this update, but the unlisted one before it: the alarm system only has a 1/3 chance of spawning

notes.title: Halloween Update is here!
notes.content:
Happy Hauntings, burglars!
A Halloween update is here and features some exciting content!

A New Map: The Facility
The Facility is a randomly generated map AND you get to pick its size (small, medium, or large)!

A Halloween Event
Head on over to Riverglen to find the missing pieces to win a prize and explore fun easter eggs!

New Alarm System
Crime is rising and ghosts are starting to take security measures! Some maps now have an alarm system that needs to be disabled. If accidentally triggered, you will have 30 seconds to disarm it before the cops arrive!

Other Stuff

 3 Masks have been added
 Gold mask is easier to see
 Death screen displays random text
 Other minor changes and bug fixes


🎃Happy Halloween!👻

notes.title: Overhaul Update
notes.content:
Hello boo-glars!
As we approach spooky season, many quality of life changes and behind-the-scenes reworking needed to be done to pave way for future updates! This update took a lot longer than usual because the entire game needed to be restructured in order to pull it off + some efforts have shifted to a new and exciting project! 
This game will be seeing a lot of exciting updates in the near future, but for now this update brings you:

Custom Game Mode
Not only can you now completely customize your heist (and still get paid!), but you can also play against multiple boo men!

Nightmare Difficulty
Same settings as insane, only now you are going up against 2 random boo men

Quality of Life

Regular Changes:

Random map option
Reworked The Troll to where when he roars, there is a chance it will break the lights
Moved 'Monster Mode' to the regular lobby so players can conveniently swap between modes
Item finder doll is a lot more accurate
Revive doll is a little better too I guess
Players can now equip perks in the lobby
Updated the client's lobby to see the host's selections
PvP:

Added Cynthia to PvP
Reworked The Troll to reflect changes to the actual Troll + you can now see players in the light when using your roar ability
Boo Men no longer get a hint or notification when players are on the last item
Perks:

Night Light: You get 3 flares instead of 1
Seeker: Lasts 80 seconds (use to be 30) and get an auditory alert when you are near the item
Lock Picker: Unlocking only takes 8-16 seconds (use to be 16-36)
Goosebumps: Cooldown has been reduced from 12 seconds to 8 seconds.
Bugs + other minor changes:

Fixed Ghost Girl crashing the game after killing everyone
Reduced Mimic's chase speed
Lobby options save after each round
Minor updates to regular mode difficulty payout and item quantity in multiplayer

notes.title: Small Patch 5/31
notes.content:
Updated host + client lobby screens along with a boo guide, but those were supposed to be in the next update.

notes.title: The Cynthia Update
notes.content:
Boo!
Happy whateverdaythisupdatecomesout day! I am excited to share with you this big and fun update! There is a lot to explore, so here is the breakdown:


New Boo Man - Cynthia

New Map (Small) - Cubicle Gardens

Helper Dolls:
Helper dolls will spawn under certain conditions (unless playing on insane) and will aid you in your heist!
[olist]
The Voodoo Doll: When a burglar dies, a voodoo doll containing their soul will spawn somewhere on the map. If a living player interacts with this doll, it will revive that player (one per person).
The Item Finder: This doll will spawn at the start of every heist, but should be saved for desperate times. Interact with this doll and it will -try its best- to lead you to a random, unfound item.
The Breaker Doll: This doll will only appear during power outages (but in the same location each round). If you ever find yourself cornered and far away from the breaker, look for this glowing doll and he will take care of it for you!
[/olist]
Monster Mode:
[olist]
Added Ghost Girl
Made the Mimic slightly slower and added a cooldown for turning off the lights
The Scav can hear players through walls
Fixed Edith's ability not always working
[/olist]
Quality of Life + Other:
[olist]
Dead burglars can see other dead burglars as spoopy ghosts
Added customization options for shirt color
Light bulbs now actually glow for extra immersion
Revamped tutorial
Minor bug fixes that I will find out are not actually fixed two days from now
[/olist]


Remember you can hop on down to the discord posted somewhere on the store page and add feedback as the game keeps evolving!
Thank you and keep stealing from old ladies!

notes.title: Monster Mode Update 3
notes.content:
Thank you all for your feedback! This gamemode is still evolving and hopefully this update points it in the right direction!

In this update...

Added Mimic as a playable boo man
(Monster Mode only) Buffed all 3 other boo men
-Scav now has a passive 'Sense' ability
-Edith is faster and has a passive 'Stalk' ability
-The Troll will briefly activate all glow sticks when using his roar + charge ability
Garage doors can now be opened (lazily) to allow for an alternate exit to the escape car
Fixed bug where players weren't returning to lobby after each round
Fixed audio replicating to all players instead of only the one playing as a boo man
Made Ghost Girl slower on classic mode


Thank you all and happy haunts!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Edith is now a playable ghost.
I am still taking feedback for the new Monster Mode and this update currently doesn't reflect on that feedback (other than interact to kill being less spammable).
Future updates to this new mode will eventually reflect on feedback as I include more playable ghosts!

notes.title: A new gamemode...
notes.content:
Monster Mode is an experimental gamemode where YOU play as the ghost against your friends!
 All rules for boo men still apply and you can currently play as either the Scav or the Troll (all boo men will be included soon)! This experimental phase is to gather player feedback to guide the direction of this new gamemode as it evolves!

Everything in this update includes:

Monster Mode (Experimental)
New Masks
Alternate route on Liminal Spaces for those who want to avoid the dizzy tunnel
Glowsticks no longer replicate


Feel free to post any ideas/feedback/bugs on here or the discord: https://discord.gg/n54VXN5AaJ

Thank you!

:)

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Hello boo-glars! This update features some quality of life changes/additions:


Difficulty overhaul:
-Boo men will start off easy and get harder depending on the number of items collected
-Boo men's difficulty now scaled to level difficulty
-Updated reward bonus and items off of the chosen difficulty
New spectate system: When killed, the player can now walk around as a ghost in multiplayer (all items will be hidden)
New perk: Lock Picker - Hold action key to lock pick any locked doors!
Last item hint: When one item remains, a hint for its location will be revealed
Added sound when collecting an item
Added money to Liminal Spaces
Fixed lights only flickering for host
Updated prize money for each level
Other bug fixes and minor improvements to AI

notes.content:
This content update brings a new map which features a variety of liminal spaces -hence the name!
There might be some tricks in this map to throw you off your burglar game, so be weary of your surroundings! 

This map also comes with two new related masks and some minor gameplay adjustments and bug fixes.


I still might make additions to this map, but I promise the next one will be a size small! The next update I plan on focusing more around quality of life and adding more to the gameplay itself!

Note: If you lost any money or may have corrupted a save in a previous update, please pm me in discord and I will correct it!

notes.title: The Mimic Update
notes.content:
A new Boo Man was among us all along! 
Introducing... -who you thought was just Tim- ...The Mimic!
The Mimic can disguise as a player to travel through the light, but be weary of anyone running for the switch.

In this update:

The Mimic
Added a timer for those who want to speedrun*
Keys now glow in the dark when you are near them
The Troll now only glows when chasing after a player
Fixed ghosts not being able to enter the cabins on Camp Suydam


*The timer starts as soon as you drop into the level (swoosh sound effect) and will stop as soon as you touch the escape car!

I know this update took a long time and there are probably going to be some (hopefully only minor) bugs, but I will adjust the Mimic based on player feedback so nothing is currently set in stone! 
For the next update I will continue to fix bugs and possibly add some more stuff to the market, but I will be experimenting with a new fun map that will hopefully add some twists into the game...

You can @ me on discord or pm me because even though I read everything, I am bad at communicating.

-Twisted

notes.title: PERKS ARE HERE!
notes.content:
Happy 2023 burglars! 
I am excited to announce that there are 6 perks now available in the market!


Seeker: Make any random item glow!
Electrician: Longer lasting power!
Goosebumps: Get notified when near a boo man!
Safe n' Sound: Doubles the chance of a safe spawning!
Witch Doctor: Grants a second life!
Night Light: Emergency flare to save yourself from a boo man!


There will be more perks added in the future along with changes to the current perks following this update (based on community feedback/ideas)!

Other minor changes have been made to Edith and the Troll as well as some bug fixes.

Happy New Year!

-Twisted

notes.title: Status and Pending Updates!
notes.content:
Hello burglars!

Thank you to everyone for contributing to the community and helping with feedback and issues! This is a status update on the near future of the game and why it has been a while since the last update.

To rip the band-aid off -I have been having a lot of issues running the project and UE4. My PC seems to be nearing its inevitable end as I am experiencing countless crashes each day and corrupted saves. I am hoping I can ride it out a bit longer with upgrades, but it has been delaying updates for the game.

The next update which I hope to have sometime in the next 2 weeks will include

A new Boo Man!! (He's a bit sensitive to glow sticks!)
Additional settings features such as (VSync, FOV slider, motion blur, etc...)
    (This will include a 2nd round of fixing the saving resetting each time)
Minor bug fixes and additional changes
2nd round testing for achievements not working for some players
No more starting in VR I hope...


Features that are also being focused on now for a near-future update include:

Keeping parties together after each round
Proximity voice chat
Option for host to toggle player collision
A new map!
More Masks!
Extra customization options!


There are more feedback items that were not included that are still on the radar! Sorry this has been taking so long! Thank you everyone again for providing feedback and bugs in the discord and discussions!

-Twisted Corridor
